gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-chorasmi: Noto Sans Chorasmian has curves that stop short of closing, with a big x-height under low ascenders. Noto Sans Chorasmian against Press Start 2P's pinned-apart, cut-out spacing makes a retro, playful quirk the strongest thing here.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, with spacing like cut-out letters pinned far apart and only a faint stem-to-join difference. And Noto Sans Coptic settles beneath it, its middle zone dominant and its s and c mouths uncrowded.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-cuneifor: Arcade fun, then glass beads. Press Start 2P is best at mild, approachable stroke contrast and wide-set letters, while Noto Sans Cuneiform does its best work with an e that opens up and a lowercase swollen like inflated glass.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Press Start 2P is playful and retro, with measured thick-thin strokes. Its best trick is those big lowercase bowls and widely pinned spacing, while Noto Sans Deseret counters with open apertures and a wide, high lowercase that keeps legibility easy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Press Start 2P goes retro and fun, its thick strokes only slightly heavier than the thin ones. But Noto Sans Duployan, with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, would carry a longer passage in a clean, contemporary way.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Large, plain-sans lowercase with open terminals that never pinch shut. Press Start 2P adds retro fun on top, its joins thinning gently without turning spindly, and Noto Sans Elbasan keeps the text underneath grounded and contemporary.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with a steady, mellow modulation under the eye and cut-out letter spacing. Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Letters pinned far apart like cut-outs, thin strokes of respectable weight: that is Press Start 2P, fun and retro in every line. Noto Sans Ethiopic stands under it, tall and sturdy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Playful, retro Press Start 2P leads with thick strokes that guide the eye without dominating it. Noto Sans Georgian follows with open curves and short ascender stems, so a longer passage reads modern and clean.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-glagolit: Press Start 2P has a retro, fun streak and a lettering-pen steadiness in its moderate stem-to-hairline ratio. Noto Sans Glagolitic brings the strongest quality: round, open letters that stay clear at small sizes.
